verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de has a documented REST API. You can submit documents for notarization, with AI detection of signature fields, and create incorporation, translation and trade-registration requests. The tax-registration endpoint is the clearest fit: it generates an ELSTER XML document from submitted company data and sends it to the tax office. These are task-specific workflow endpoints rather than general programmatic generation and population of arbitrary legal documents from templates, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: general document generation/templating with field population, evidence that incorporation generates populated legal documents, a machine-readable API spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
